parameters.description:
`discord-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native Discord webhook payload (e.g. {"content": "..."} or {"embeds": [...]}). The gateway forwards the request to the webhook URL in your stored secret, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored webhook; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment webhooks via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay a message to your own Discord channel by posting a native Discord webhook payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

webhook_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Discord webhook URL
